raw_segments.text: Not that more glorious, when the angels met Jacob in Mahanaim, where he saw the field
Nor that, which on the flaming mount appeared in Dothan, covered with a camp of fire against
the Syrian king, who to surprise one man assassin-like had levied war, war unproclaimed.
The princely hierarch in their bright stand there left his powers, to sighs possession
He alone, to find where Adam sheltered, took his way, not unperceived of Adam.
Who to Eve, while the great visitant approached thus spake?
